reviewNotes: Reviewed all 22 cards and 86 distinct exported speech keys against data/pages83.json vocabulary/furigana. Verified pork cut names including 鞍下 くらした, 背脂 せあぶら, shoulder/belly cuts, 内モモ うちもも and 外モモ そともも. Preserved distinct source readings 豚トロ ぶたとろ and 豚(とん)トロ とんとろ under their separate lookup keys. Supplied residual kanji and converted katakana to hiragana while retaining long vowels in ろーす/てーる. Reviewed contextual topic は, directional へ and object を; preserved lexical はらがわ. All questions and explanations use Nova generation speed 1.0; individual vocabulary and short vocabulary groups use 0.85. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
